title: Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Constrained Clustering from Entangled Pairwise Supervision
claim: A cyclic estimate–correct–integrate pipeline refines noisy supervision step by step, with feedback from the integrator improving the estimators.
layout: 1 panel, left-to-right three dashed modules, feedback loop arrow along bottom
description: A single wide left-to-right diagram with three large rounded dashed-border modules, colored blue (Estimators), green (Correctors) and orange (Integrator). Each holds stacked cards (Est^(K), Cor_E, Int) and notation for its parameters and loss. Black input arrows come from the top (data x, descriptors φ_i, labels y_i). Small gray boxes (concat, difference, add & soft-clip) sit above the Correctors. A gray reliability-aware screening / BC fusion box sits between Correctors and Integrator and outputs y^BC and w_i. Block arrows lead out of each module. The Integrator's output z^int flows to a red Clustering box at the right. A long orange feedback arrow along the bottom returns y^int and w_i to the Estimators. The eye starts at the blue Estimators on the left and follows the flow rightward.
caption: Overview of the ECI-PP pipeline. The Estimators are trained with the ProbPair objective $\mathcal{L}$ ([ref]) and produce out-of-fold beliefs $\hat{y}_i^{\mathrm{oof}}$ via the readout in [ref]. The Correctors take $[\hat{y}_i^{\mathrm{oof}};\phi_i]$ as input, with $\phi_i$ the pair-$i$ descriptor, and learn probability-space corrections $\hat{\Delta}_i$ via [ref], yielding corrected relations $y_i^{\mathrm{cor}}$. Reliability-aware screening produces reliability weights $w_i$, and BC fusion forms the refined supervision $y_i^{\mathrm{BC}}$ via [ref]. The Integrator learns embeddings from the refined supervision; its Integrator-side relations $y_i^{\mathrm{int}}$ are fed back to the Estimators for iterative refinement, while the final embeddings $\mathcal{Z}^{\mathrm{int}}$ are clustered into the final partition.
abstract: Pairwise constrained clustering typically relies on hard must-link/cannot-link labels, whereas realistic pairwise supervision may be real-valued and entangle intrinsic ambiguity, expert judgment, and stochastic corruption. Existing deep constrained clustering (DCC) methods mainly target hard, expert-agnostic constraints, treating soft labels mostly numerically rather than semantically. We formalize this setting as uncertainty-aware probabilistic constrained clustering (UPCC), defining a canonical aleatoric relation through a heterogeneous observation process and analyzing its conditional identifiability. We introduce ProbPair, an angular pairwise objective for probabilistic relations, and build ECI-PP, an estimator--corrector--integrator framework that refines imperfect supervision via belief estimation, correction, and reliability-aware integration. Across challenging probabilistic supervision settings, experiments on diverse benchmarks show that ECI-PP outperforms state-of-the-art DCC methods and remains robust with a shared default configuration.
